main_measure.name: mean of (forecast/10) x excess 4-bar return after settlement
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean product > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean product < 0 with t <= -2; at least 300 episodes

supporting_check.name: excess 4-bar return, largest-|forecast| third minus smallest third

decided_by: the mean product is above 0 with t >= 2 and the top-minus-bottom third difference is below 0
reading: Entry bars are those stamped 23:00, 07:00 or 15:00 with forecast < 0 whose bar 4 rows later is exactly 4 h later in the same window; the coin's mean 4-bar return uses the non-overlapping grid of each window pooled over all windows; thirds are n//3 episodes by |forecast| pooled over coins and windows.
